EROSION OF COMPRESSOR ROTOR BLADES / VANES: 
 Label each stage as either N (None), "A" "B" or "C" for leading edge 
 erosion.

THICKNESS OF TRAILING EDGE
 Measure and record the trailing edge thick ness of one blade / vane 
 per stage. If the trailing edges are eroded, enter an "E" after the 
 reading. If no erosion is evident mark "N" for None after the reading.

CRACKS
 Check for cracks and mark "N" for 
 No cracks, or mark the number of cracked blades / vanes per stage. Note : 
 Any crack means mandatory rejection of the blade / vane
